about: A MADE-UP idea for `python -m machine.demo`. The words are invented (not the trader's). talker_answer is written by hand in the exact shape the talker's ONE Claude tool call returns (machine/talker/translate.py: fill_idea_form), so the demo runs with no key and no call; code checks it exactly as it checks a real answer. stand_in_answers stands in for the trader's reply to the question (in the real machine he answers on Telegram, after seeing pictures).
words: sell when the high is taken, then the break soon after and the first gap, sell at the gap
